#!/usr/bin/env sh

ROOT=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)

elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHON=python

fi
exec "$PYTHON" "$ROOT/cpf-tools/runtime/cli/cpf.py" --root "$ROOT" "$@"
